site.name: Paccradle
site.title: Paccradle: box inserts from one photo
site.description: Put your product on A4 or Letter paper, take one photo, and get a cut-ready box insert plus a matching box. Check the fit in 3D, then export SVG, PDF or DXF.
footer.tagline: Box inserts that fit, from one photo.
footer.paddle: Payments are processed by Paddle.com, our merchant of record.
hero.title: Snap your product. Get a box insert that fits it.
hero.title.line2: Get a box insert that fits your
hero.lead: Put your product on a sheet of A4 or Letter paper and take one photo. Paccradle measures it, designs an insert that holds it, sizes a matching box, and shows you the fit in 3D before you print.
hero.note: Design and preview for free. Pay only when you download production files.
hero.illustration: An unfolded cradle insert on a sheet of paper: cut lines solid, fold lines dashed, three bottle holes with fit rings. Its walls fold up and down.
hero.caption: Cradle insert · 3 × 30 ml · E-flute
marquee.label: What people pack, and what they cut it with
demo.title: See it work
demo.lead: Photo to insert in about a minute.
how.title: How it works
how.lead: From a photo to files your printer can cut.
how.step1.title: Take one photo on paper
how.step1.body: Put your product on A4 or US Letter paper and photograph it from above. The paper is the ruler. For the most exact fit, trace around the product with a pen and photograph the outline instead.
how.step2.title: Pick an insert
how.step2.body: Choose a partition grid, a cutout card or a raised cradle, and your board: paperboard, chipboard or corrugated. A matching mailer or shipping box is sized for you.
how.step3.title: Check the fit, then export
how.step3.body: Watch it fold in 3D with every hole colored by clearance. Print a free test on your home printer, then download cut-ready SVG, PDF or DXF files.
features.title: Everything you need to get it made
features.inserts.title: Three insert styles
features.inserts.body: Partition grids for rows of bottles and jars, cutout cards for tubes and small items, and cradle platforms for premium bottles.
features.box.title: A matching outer box
features.box.body: A mailer or shipping box sized around your insert, with inside and outside measurements.
features.fit.title: 3D fold and fit check
features.fit.body: Know it fits before you pay a printer.
features.test.title: Free print-at-home test
features.test.body: Your insert tiled across A4 or Letter sheets with alignment marks, so you can build a paper prototype in minutes.
features.files.title: Production files
features.files.body: Separate cut and crease layers, for printers, die makers, lasers, CNC tables and Cricut.
features.checks.title: Built-in checks
features.checks.body: Warnings for holes too close to an edge or a fold, slots that don't match your board, and pieces too big for your sheet.

faq.title: Questions
faq.export.a: Downloading the production files (SVG, PDF and DXF) for one design. Previews and the watermarked test PDF are always free.
faq.edit.q: Can I change a design after paying?
faq.edit.a: Yes. You can edit an unlocked design for 30 days and download its files again at any time.
faq.paddle.a: Paddle.com is our merchant of record. Paddle handles the payment, sales tax and receipts.
faq.refund.a: Yes. The Refund Policy explains how and when.
